caption: The drawing depicts a stone object composed of two distinct sections: the lower part is a roughly hewn, rectangular block with an irregular and textured surface, rendered in various shades of gray and beige to convey a stone-like material. The upper part of the object features a more refined, carved segment topped with a rounded arch. This upper segment is intricately decorated with swirling, spiral motifs and organic patterns, giving the appearance of detailed relief carving. The carved portion is also shaded in gray tones with detailed highlights and shadows to emphasize the depth and intricacy of the patterns. The background is plain and unadorned, allowing the central stone object to stand out clearly. The name "ROSE CAMPBELL-GERKE" is written in small letters below the object.
title: Stone Gate Post
